 first_record;

PROCEDURE Validate_new_product (p_unit_id in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date ,
 p_chapter_id in varchar2,
 p_product_code in varchar2,
 p_bag_id in varchar2,
 p_old_product_code in varchar2,
 p_process in varchar2,
 p_weight in number ) is

 -- This procedure is essentially a copy of INSERT_COMPONENT (from SBCLIB:LIB)
 -- without the actual insertion into the components table and also without Interdiction
 -- checks. This has been put here to be called before we print labels, so that we don't 
 -- print a label and discover only at the time of verification that the component cannot
 -- actually be made. --HCLC Code128 
 

 -- P_OLD_PRODUCT_CODE is an overloaded field used as follows
 -- depending on P_PROCESS:
 -- MODIFY CONVERT SPIKED stores old product code
 -- DEFINE stores number of bags used
 -- REJECT stores the reject reason_code
 temp_time_limit number(10,2);
 temp_max_temp number(10,2);
 temp_min_temp number(10,2);
 temp_min_weight number(10,2);
 temp_max_weight number(10,2);
 temp_checkin_min_temp number(10,2);
 temp_checkin_max_temp number(10,2);
 temp_max_bleed_time number;
 temp_slow_bleed_time number;
 temp_bags_used number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_first_sep_time date;
 temp_second_sep_time date;
 temp_third_sep_time date;
 temp_cryo_time date;
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_pheresis_flag VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_return_val VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_contract_id VARCHAR2(9);
 temp_product_type VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_time_difference VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_ffp_freeze_durn VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_calculated_time VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_p_name varchar2(30) := name_in('banner.prog_name'); 
 temp_u_id varchar2(10) := name_in('banner.user_id'); 
begin
 copy(p_unit_id,'GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 copy(p_chapter_id,'GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 copy(to_char(p_coll_date),'GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 copy(p_product_code,'GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 begin
 select ffp_freeze_durn, max_bleed_time, slow_bleed_time
 into temp_ffp_freeze_durn,
 temp_max_bleed_time, temp_slow_bleed_time
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from chapter');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select max_temp, min_temp, time_limit, product_type,
 nvl(pheresis_flag,'N')
 into temp_max_temp, temp_min_temp,
 temp_time_limit, temp_product_type, temp_pheresis_flag
 from valid_products
 --where product_code = p_product_code and /*HCL Consulting */
 where product_code = substr(p_product_code,1,5) and
 sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from valid_products');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select first_sep_time, second_sep_time,
 third_sep_time, bleed_start_time,
 bleed_end_time, contract_id
 into temp_first_sep_time, temp_second_sep_time,
 temp_third_sep_time, temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_bleed_end_time, temp_contract_id
 from units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date) and
 units.chapter_id = p_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in selecting from units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_pheresis_flag = 'N' and
 temp_contract_id = 'INTERNAL'
 then
 if temp_product_type in ('PLT','DUPLT')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is null or
 temp_second_sep_time is null
 then
 show_error('0138');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('WB','DUWB')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is not null
 then
 show_error('0260');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('FFP','RPL','RPFF',
 'DUFFP','DURPL','DURPF')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is null
 then
 show_error('0083');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('FFP','DUFFP')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is not null and
 temp_second_sep_time is not null and
 temp_third_sep_time is not null
 then
 show_error('0079');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('RBC','DURBC','LEUKO','DULEU')
 then
 if temp_first_sep_time is null
 then
 show_error('0084');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if temp_time_limit is not null
 then
 -- message('Entered check for time interdiciton');
 if temp_product_type in ('RBC','DURBC','LEUKO','DULEU')
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_first_sep_time);
 -- message('a:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('PLT','DUPLT')
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_second_sep_time);
 -- message('b1:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('CRYO','DUCRYO')
 then
 begin
 select decode(sep_ind,2,temp_second_sep_time,
 3,temp_third_sep_time,null)
 into temp_cryo_time
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date);
 if temp_cryo_time is null
 then
 message ('no data selecting from cryo units');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 message ('error selecting from cryo units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_cryo_time);
 -- message('b2:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 end if;
 if temp_product_type in ('FFP','RPFF','DUFFP','DURPF')
 then
 if temp_second_sep_time is not null
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_second_sep_time);
 --message('c:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 else
 temp_time_difference :=
 sbclib.calculate_time(temp_bleed_start_time,
 temp_first_sep_time);
 --message('d:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 end if;
 temp_ffp_freeze_durn :=
 to_char(to_number(temp_ffp_freeze_durn),'009.99');
 if temp_time_difference is not null
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 to_char(
 to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,1,3))+
 to_number(substr(temp_ffp_freeze_durn,2,3))
 )||'.'||
 lpad(to_char(
 to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,5,2))+
 to_number(substr(temp_ffp_freeze_durn,6,2)))
 ,2,'0');
 --message('f:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 temp_time_difference :=
 to_char(to_number(temp_time_difference),'009.99');
 if to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,6,2)) >= 60
 then
 temp_time_difference :=
 to_char(
 to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,2,3))+1)
 ||'.'||
 to_char(
 to_number(substr(temp_time_difference,6,2))-60);
 --message('g:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 end if;
 temp_time_difference :=
 to_char(to_number(temp_time_difference),'009.99');
 --message('f.1:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 end if;
 end if;
 -- message('h:temp_time_difference:'||temp_time_difference);
 copy('N','GLOBAL.time_interdiction');
 if temp_time_difference is null
 then
 -- time difference is more than 999 hours or some
 -- other error
 message('Erroneous time difference');
 copy('Y','GLOBAL.time_interdiction');
 else
 temp_time_difference := ltrim(temp_time_difference);
 temp_time_difference :=
 substr(temp_time_difference,1,3)||'.'||
 to_char(round(to_number(
 substr(temp_time_difference,5,2))*100/60));
 -- message('Time difference: '||temp_time_difference);
 -- message('Time Limit: '||to_char(temp_time_limit));
 if to_number(temp_time_difference) > temp_time_limit
 then
 copy('Y','GLOBAL.time_interdiction');
 end if;
 end if;
 /* if name_in('GLOBAL.time_interdiction') = 'Y'
 then
 message('Msg:Component has CMTI interdiction.');
 temp_return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 p_unit_id,
 p_coll_date ,
 p_chapter_id,
 p_product_code,
 'CMTI',temp_u_id,
 temp_p_name);
 if temp_return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CMTI not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if; */
 end if;
 end if;
 -- set bags_used based on procedure
 if p_process = 'REJECT'
 then
 temp_bags_used := 1;
 elsif p_process = 'DEFINE'
 then -- bags used passed as old_product_code
 temp_bags_used := to_number(p_old_product_code);
 elsif p_process in ('MODIFY','CONVERT')
 then -- bags used based on altered product
 begin
 -- aliquotted products will be stopped prior to this point
 select decode(v.product_type,'DUFFP',1,nvl(bags_used,1))
 into temp_bags_used
 from valid_products v, components c
 where c.unit_id = p_unit_id
 and trunc(c.coll_date) = trunc(p_coll_date)
 and c.chapter_id = p_chapter_id
 and c.product_code = p_old_product_code
 -- and v.product_code = p_old_product_code; /*HCL Consulting */
 and v.product_code = substr(p_old_product_code,1,5); /*HCL Consulting */
 exception
 when others
 then
 message ('Error checking bags used');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif p_process = 'SPIKED'
 then -- 4hr expiration, no need to worry about viability, always 1 bag
 temp_bags_used := 1;
 end if;
 if p_process in ('REJECT','DEFINE','CONVERT','SPIKED') and
 temp_bags_used > 1
 then
 reconcile_bags(p_unit_id,p_coll_date,
 p_chapter_id,temp_count,
 temp_bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if temp_count < temp_bags_used
 then
 show_error('0135');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
END;

synchronize;
